emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure (score 1.745) overtakes Memory/HBM (2.34) as the confirmed leader — a CONFIRMED handoff (AI Infra's score surpassing Memory's and holding, not a single tick) would retire this watch; until then Memory remains the leader.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Prevailing narrative with the highest score and broad breadth (0.75), still eligible under the trend gate and not crowded (z 0.53). But Hurst is mixed, which tempers trend persistence; the call rests on the trend gate still holding and leadership not having rolled over, not on the rank itself.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag means the trend is not clean; momentum rank has ~0 forward IC in clean universes, so this lead may be attention rather than durable edge, and a challenger (AI Infra) is only 0.595 behind.

falsifier.text: SMH loses its absolute-trend eligibility (per the gate) before the check-by date, or Memory's score gap over AI Infrastructure closes to near zero

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Strong durability (0.85) with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and the highest breadth (0.917), eligible and uncrowded. This is the trend-gate leg doing its job: a high-durability, high-breadth theme that is not extended, suggesting staying power rather than a return forecast.
theses.dissent: ETFs for this theme share the SMH proxy with several other semiconductor themes, so score contamination is likely; the theme may not be independently identifiable and its rank-5 momentum is unremarkable.

falsifier.text: AI Semiconductors' durability bar drops toward the mixed-tag peers' level (below ~0.7) while its breadth narrows below 0.7

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 3 with the highest breadth (0.9) among top themes, clean 'trend' Hurst, and the highest durability bar (0.76). The crowding z (1.82) is a size-down caution only — not a fade — so the lean stays positive while acknowledging the theme is extended.
theses.dissent: Crowded (z 1.82) and occupying a popular narrative; crowding marks tops more often than continuation, so the safer read is to size down rather than add.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding z sustains above ~2.0 while its breadth or score stalls, indicating the theme is rolling over rather than consolidating

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
